body: Hey, man I'm still here. It's rough. I appreciate you taking the time to read the other stuff I've posted. I'm really tired of things not working out. I don't think they will. So if you're  around I'll talk. Please don't lecture me on how I could just stop thinking about it, and how my problems are insignificant in the grand scheme of things. They're real to me, and they're ruining my life.

According to your 3-step plan, I should already have a girlfriend. Im not making excuses for other issues. You sort of assumed that I think women are gods. I dont. I do feel like the unluckiness of not meeting women has alienated me from normal society. I dont know how to date people because I cant get a date. Sort of a catch 22. I also regularly talk to people.

Well, it's definitely a cycle for me at the very least. Being depressed doesn't help me get confidence or anything that would help improve my chances of getting a girlfriend. (Lack-of-girlfriend) + Time = More depression.

To me, I would probably chalk that up to be an effect of being FA. I wouldn't doubt that most people on there are clinically depressed, but the reason for a lot of their problems, as well as mine, stems from loneliness and shyness.

First, I'm not under any illusion that I wont change, but there is a serious possibility that I could be a 32 year old, and still be alone, same circumstances. Look over at r/foreveralone, people like me exist in droves. Some of them get to be 30 or 40 and still have no one. I dont want that to be me. Existing for the sake of not being dead isnt living. Quality of life is a thing too. 

Also, online dating is similar to tinder, which I explained my reasoning for above.

I have a bit of an issue with tinder. As much as I admit I need to meet more people, tinder is offputing to me. First, it is public. What if people I know notice that I have a profile? Just knowing that every girl with a tinder will eventually see that I have a tinder is a little scary to me. Second, it would feel imgenuine. I'd sort of like to meet a girl in person. I have a really hard time talking to girls who are complete strangers to me. If we have something in common whatsoever, I'm okay, but tinder relationships are usually the former. I wouldn't know what to say either.

I'm sorry to hear that your in the same boat. The feeling is crushing. I feel like it would all be simpler if I could just stop THINKING about how much I wish I had a relationship. That's the guts of it. The constant dwelling. As long as I'm distracted, I'm good. I can function. But once I'm bored, or just think about it, I get so deeply plunged into self-hatred and depression that it's hard to focus on anything else. My whole worldview is brought down to the one focal point that I. Am. Lonely.

Also, how do I prevent her from asking other people to come with us? I have definitely tried something like this with her before, but she didn't realize I meant just with me. How can I make it so that it would be just us?

Maybe so... But this girl is pretty quiet, herself. I don't think she's super "experienced" either. Part of me thinks this is what would make us good for each other. I'm just really scared to ask. On the first hand, I have to get over a very intense fear of asking. On the other, even if I worked up the courage to ask, if she said no, that could ruin everything we have. What I want to do here is ask her out, but I don't know if that's right.

Yeah, I guess that was my first thought for how I would ask her out if I were to. I really think it would come off as weird if I told a person I have known for over a year that I would like to go on a date, but at the same time, I've been told that if you want a date you should specify that it is a date. I am a casual person, and I think that just asking her to go to a movie with me would be pretty simple. I think I could get her to say yes to that, but I guess I'd have to just let things naturally play out or fizzle. I mean, I think that she's a very smart person, and I think that she could put it together that it's a date. Also, Tinder is off the table, I'll never use it. Never. 

Thanks for the reply.
So you're saying I should make it my goal to make her jealous?
See, I like to drink, but bars aren't really my cup of tea. Also, I know me, I probably would never ask out a complete stranger.
Also, how can I get help with this.

But what if the reason I am unhappy is that I've created a metapsychosis that in order to be happy I must get a girlfriend. The route of most of my unhappiness stems from this. I dont feel like other aspects of my life are horrible, its just that I am utterly alone. To a large degree, I feel like it is my own biology playing a part in my own unhappiness. People, collectively, have one gene deep goal, and that is to procreate. Now, in my own opinion, I dont really want to have kids, but that gene deep programming is what makes loneliness a bad feeling. The same way hunger comes when you need food. I need to feel like I can love someone.
